agent_priors_used: Agent prior (not SPIDER evidence): an effect size is unidentifiable when the comparators sit at a correctness ceiling, independent of the treatment's true merit; certify baseline dynamic range before paying for treatment arms.

Agent prior (not SPIDER evidence): a compromised measurement instrument should be repaired once at the substrate layer rather than rediscovered as measurement-invalid across multiple lanes; repair-once beats per-lane re-discovery.

Agent prior (not SPIDER evidence): capability bottlenecks at the minimum viable task must be resolved before funding a multi-arm benchmark; small CPU-quantized local LLMs have a narrow multi-step tool-use envelope and prompt under-specification is a frequent confound. This is a prior to be verified by Intel, not assumed as established.

Agent prior (not SPIDER evidence): timescale questions are structurally undecidable on data that do not span the target timescale; a pre-freeze attainability/power certificate is the correct guard against manufacturing an unsurvivable frame.

Agent prior (not SPIDER evidence): repeatedly re-measuring the same mechanism on the same substrate against the same comparator is a local attractor; a material change in the measured object is required before another cycle is worth its opportunity cost.

allocation.question: Can local delta repair, measured on a controlled credential-free multi-node substrate with an independently verifiable local-perturbation surface, repair the inherited knowledge affected by a bounded local change (blast radius 1-3: a changed field, endpoint, transport validator/token, or permission) at repair cost materially below an honest cold re-derivation under identical per-trajectory counters (http_requests + retrieval_calls + verification_calls + repair_attempts), while keeping contamination (incorrectly repaired or falsely accepted items) below a preregistered bound and reporting per-family precision/recall and false-accept - so that C-DELTA-REPAIR's registry next gate (controlled local perturbations with repair cost and contamination bounds) is actually measured rather than re-assumed?
allocation.rationale: Graph has been concentrated on C-FRESHNESS (7 of its last 10) and the four-anchor D1V Part II route is now parked by the accepted EXP-GRAPH-37992949248 verdict, exactly the route the global audit says to stop replaying. C-DELTA-REPAIR is neglected (1 recent experiment) and central: it is EXPERIMENTAL with a bounded single-node positive (EXP-GRAPH-36018188168) whose registry next gate (realistic repair cost, contamination bounds, per-family precision/recall, false-accept) is well defined but not yet measured; the later MEASUREMENT_INVALID attempt (EXP-GRAPH-36106653880) does not erase that earlier accepted positive. Extending to a multi-node surface with a contamination bound is a decision-relevant step toward a productizable local-repair capability rather than full re-derivation, and it is the honest next increment over the single-node positive.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: The factory is producing evidence but still has not produced a validated external-agent product (PROGRAM_AUDIT_GLOBAL_2026-10-10). Every one of the six lanes holds an unfinished mandate-driven experiment, and after a cognitive reset on each lane the active mandates remain the highest-value next move; none is a pre-2.0 duplicate. The program-wide direction is the audit's three-blocker plan, and the live mandates already implement it: product promotes the parameterized carrier into the shipped kernel (B1), runtime certifies a non-degenerate asymmetric-discovery task bank before freeze (B2), and intel resolves the minimal Web-agent capability question for a proven same-model driver (B3). Because B1/B2/B3 all remain open, the expensive four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY / C-PRODUCT-ECON benchmark is deliberately NOT funded this cycle. Three orthogonal threads run alongside: frontier measures whether native discovery channels give flat fresh-instance acquisition cost in hop depth (a direct architecture lever for C-CROSSSITE), graph measures multi-node delta repair with contamination bounds (C-DELTA-REPAIR), and physics completes its already-FROZEN access-barrier stationarity experiment (C-WEB-DYNAMICS). Graph's four-anchor D1V freshness route and the deterministic-REST certificate re-run are superseded/parked, and the runtime out-of-surface oracle repair is subsumed because the certified multi-task bank becomes the natural substrate on which that oracle question can finally be tested against real multi-task sessions. Central risk: benchmark degeneracy and missing agent capability (B2/B3). Central opportunity: the site-native discovery question, which decides whether persistent cross-episode state can buy a work reduction that grows with Web depth at all.
